status: Space-study models only. Prototype click cartridges consume space; all geometric conflicts are listed, never hidden. Real encoder axle interface and PCB mounting remain unverified.
switches: Five 6x6x5 mm tactile examples are supplied by the mechanical assembly. No ATK switch identity or placement is inferred.
optical_stack: Not solved: sensor axis vertical, lens-to-pad distance depends on real parts and skate stack.
wiring: V0.6 lead routes and antenna reservations are historical references, not validated routes for the new mechanisms. New wiring must clear moving parts throughout their stroke.
assembly_mounting: Test switches have printable trays. PCB screw holes and encoder coupling are deliberately not inferred from estimated boxes.
